name: highlight by elementId, inline
yaml:
name: p
steps:
  - tool: highlight
    elementId: com.example:id/btn_login

name: highlight by elementId with a description under params
yaml:
name: p
steps:
  - tool: highlight
    params:
      elementId: com.example:id/btn_login
      description: Login button

name: highlight with an inline description
yaml:
name: p
steps:
  - tool: highlight
    elementId: com.example:id/btn_login
    description: Login button

name: highlight with a non-string inline description
yaml:
name: p
steps:
  - tool: highlight
    elementId: com.example:id/btn_login
    description: 5

name: highlight with no selector and no shape
yaml:
name: p
steps:
  - tool: highlight
    description: Login button

name: highlight with a legacy inline id
yaml:
name: p
steps:
  - tool: highlight
    id: com.example:id/btn_login

name: highlight with a legacy id under params
yaml:
name: p
steps:
  - tool: highlight
    params:
      id: com.example:id/btn_login

name: highlight with a non-string legacy id
yaml:
name: p
steps:
  - tool: highlight
    id: 5

name: highlight with a box shape the tool rejects
yaml:
name: p
steps:
  - tool: highlight
    shape: { type: box, bounds: { x: 1, y: 2, width: 3, height: 4 } }

name: highlight with a circle shape
yaml:
name: p
steps:
  - tool: highlight
    shape: { type: circle, bounds: { x: 1, y: 2, width: 3, height: 4 } }

name: a legacy plan with inputText and a highlight using id
yaml:
name: p
steps:
  - tool: inputText
    text: hello
  - tool: highlight
    id: com.example:id/btn_login
    description: Login button

name: dragAndDrop with a nested container and selectionStrategy
yaml:
name: p
steps:
  - tool: dragAndDrop
    source:
      text: Item 1
      selectionStrategy: unique
      container:
        elementId: com.example:id/list_a
        container:
          text: Lists
          index: 1
    target:
      text: Item 2
    dragDurationMs: 2000

name: dragAndDrop with an unknown endpoint key
dragAndDrop with a container selector that sets both elementId and text
setDeviceState with only connectivity
yaml:
name: p
steps:
  - tool: setDeviceState
    connectivity:
      airplaneMode: true

name: setDeviceState with only a static location (unquoted decimals)
yaml:
name: p
steps:
  - tool: setDeviceState
    location:
      mode: static
      latitude: 37.77
      longitude: -122.42

name: setDeviceState with a stop location under params
yaml:
name: p
steps:
  - tool: setDeviceState
    params:
      location:
        mode: stop

name: setDeviceState with a non-boolean airplaneMode
yaml:
name: p
steps:
  - tool: setDeviceState
    connectivity: { airplaneMode: maybe }

name: setDeviceState with an out-of-range latitude
yaml:
name: p
steps:
  - tool: setDeviceState
    location: { mode: static, latitude: 91, longitude: 0 }

name: setDeviceState with no device state field
yaml:
name: p
steps:
  - tool: setDeviceState
    params: {}
